subject: The 2AM setup our top 1% use
preview_text: How power users plan 4x more dates with a 30-second workflow you're missing.
body_paragraphs: Two weeks ago, a couple named Mia and Jake opened SoulPlan at 2AM. Not for a date—to set up their workflow. They mapped their moods, saved a few wishlist ideas, and tapped Tonight's Date once. That night, they had a cozy dinner on the couch, no planning fatigue, no 'what do you want to do' loop. Since then, they've planned 12 dates.

Here's what the top 1% of our users do differently: they don't wait for the spark to fade. They open the app, pick a mood (cozy, adventurous, playful, healing), and let the AI pull a single card from their wishlist. No scrolling, no second-guessing. It's like having a butler for your romance—one tap, and the night's set. The streak counter keeps them going, but the no-shame freeze means zero pressure.

You already have this. The feature is called Tonight's Date. It lives on your home screen, right next to your partner's avatar. Open it now, pick a mood, and watch the AI deliver a surprise. Your partner gets a full-screen 'thought of you tonight' moment—not a bare notification. That's the difference between routine and ritual.

Open SoulPlan and tap Tonight's Date in the next 5 minutes. Your first date this week will take 30 seconds. P.S. The couples who do this on a Tuesday night report 3x more 'spark' moments by Friday. Try it tonight.
